replication.target_description: Hypothesis to replicate and bet on: The possibility to cheat in a die-throwing game results in more dishonesty in a Boggle game after three days. The hypothesis is evaluated using a χ²-test between the percentages of cheating participants in the likely cheating treatment vs. the no- cheating treatment (χ² = 10.48, p = 0.001, n = 258, Cramer’s V = 0.20); p. 6170.
